When the same sensitive value appears many times, redaction must treat every
occurrence the same way — one value, one consistent replacement — so the
document stays internally coherent after redaction.

The primary contact is priya.rao@example.com. Copy priya.rao@example.com on
every thread, and if priya.rao@example.com bounces, fall back to the shared
inbox. All three mentions of priya.rao@example.com are the same address.

The escalation line is +1 (415) 555-0142. Ring +1 (415) 555-0142 twice; if
+1 (415) 555-0142 is busy, leave a message.

A different address, sam.diaz@example.com, appears once and is its own
entity, distinct from priya.rao@example.com.

After redaction, the two addresses must map to two distinct tokens, each
address rendered the same everywhere it occurs.
